technique_name: Describe how a computer vision based application could be used in medicine
description: Computer vision based applications can be used in a variety of medical applications, from disease diagnosis and treatment to surgical and imaging guidance. Computer vision can be used in medical imaging, such as in Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) and Computed Tomography (CT) scans, to provide doctors with a 3D view of the patient’s body.
